title: Demo: a made-up gym's private records say weekly visitors stay 40% longer. Will the Lab's rerun agree?
statement: Made-up practice data, not real research. The pretend gym's records are invented, and they're sealed so only the Lab can read them. Only the result and fingerprints come out.
